description: Reads the technical state of the WebinarIgnition connector: version, protocol, which WordPress site is connected, whether the connection is healthy. Read-only, needs no input and changes nothing. `session_id` is optional: the connection belongs to the signed-in person, so any id of this conversation finds it, and with no id the answer still reports the connected site.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

name: wi_get_connector_status
title: Read the connector status
